> 第23章 这事没完（第1页）
郁默勋还没来得及开口，容辞听到有人过来跟郁默勋打招呼，侧身看了过来，视线和林芜对了个正着。
林芜本来正客套的嘴角露着浅笑，看到容辞的那一刻，她的眼神彻底冷了下来。
她只一眼，就收回了视线，当容辞不存在的朝着郁默勋重新扬起浅笑，正想跟郁默勋说话，郁默勋却笑着看向了容辞，率先开口道：“这位是林小姐，小辞，你想认识一下吗？”
二、他知道了她和容辞之间的恩怨。
三、摆明态度。在她与容辞之间，他站容辞这边。
林芜在此之前并不知道郁默勋和容辞认识，而且关系居然还这么要好。
但郁默勋既然都这么说了，林芜哪里还不知道郁默勋是什么意思？
她冷冷道：“所以，郁总想说明天我不用到长墨报到了？”
郁默勋赞赏一笑，放下酒杯拍掌道：“林小姐当真冰雪聪明。”
郁默勋其实完全可以以更婉转的方式把意思告知林芜的。
他这么做，其实就是用行动告诉林芜，这事没有婉转的余地，他就站容辞，且他就因为容辞，才会做出这个决定的。
她没有因此而感觉难堪或羞辱，因为在她看来，长墨虽然不错，但和封家没法比，郁默勋还不够格羞辱她。
容辞看着，暖心一笑，正想跟郁默勋说话，就注意到那边封庭深和贺长柏，祁煜洺他们都朝她这边看了过来。
应该说，他们都关注着林芜，才朝这边看过来的。
可能是没想到她也出席了这个宴会。
看到她，祁煜洺和贺长柏都露出了惊讶的表情。
而封庭深脸上却什么都没有，非常平淡。
平淡的仿佛她不是他的妻子，而是未曾谋面的陌生人。

这时，林芜已经回去到了，封庭深他们便没再关注她这边了。
刘教授离开后，容辞喝了一口饮料，抬头时，却发现祁煜洺似笑非笑地在那边看着她。
看到她看过去，祁煜洺挑了下眉头，朝她举起了酒杯。
容辞皱眉，不明白祁煜洺是什么意思。
祁煜洺似乎对着她嗤笑了下，随后就移开了视线，不再关注她。
估计是觉得她和郁默勋欺负了林芜，祁煜洺这是在告诉她，这事没完。
一会后，今天晚宴的主人忙了一圈后，终于回来了。
跟他们寒暄一番后，问郁默勋：“你认识那位林小姐？”

Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Latest chapter_Chapter 23 This matter is not over. Page 1_Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Yun Zhongmi_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 23 This is not over yet (Page 1)
Before Yu Moxun had time to speak, Rong Ci heard someone coming to say hello to Yu Moxun, turned sideways and looked over, and his eyes met Lin Wu's.
Lin Wu was smiling politely, but the moment she saw Rong Ci, her eyes turned completely cold.
She looked away after just one glance. When Rong Ci smiled non-existently at Yu Moxun again, and was about to talk to Yu Moxun, Yu Moxun looked at Rong Ci with a smile, and spoke first: "This is Miss Lin, Xiao Ci, do you want to meet her?"
2. He knew about the grudge between her and Rong Ci.
3. Make your attitude clear. Between her and Rong Ci, he stood by Rong Ci.
Lin Wu didn't know that Yu Moxun and Rong Ci knew each other before, and that their relationship was so good.
But since Yu Moxun said so, how could Lin Wu still not know what Yu Moxun meant?
She said coldly: "So, Mr. Yu wants to say that I don't have to report to Changmo tomorrow?"
Yu Moxun smiled appreciatively, put down his glass and clapped his hands and said, "Miss Lin is really smart."
In fact, Yu Moxun could have told Lin Wu his meaning in a more tactful way.
What he did was actually telling Lin Wu with his actions that there was no room for euphemism in this matter, so he would stand by Rong Ci, and it was only because of Rong Ci that he made this decision.
She didn't feel embarrassed or humiliated by this, because in her opinion, although Chang Mo was good, he was incomparable to the Feng family, and Yu Moxun was not qualified to humiliate her.
Rong Ci looked at it and smiled warmly. Just as she was about to talk to Yu Moxun, she noticed that Feng Tingshen, He Changbai, and Qi Yuming were all looking towards her.
It should be said that they were all paying attention to Lin Wu, so they looked this way.
Maybe he didn't expect that she would also attend the banquet.
Seeing her, Qi Yuming and He Changbai both showed surprised expressions.
But there was nothing on Feng Tingshen's face, which was very plain.
It was as if she was not his wife, but a stranger he had never met.
At this time, Lin Wu had already returned, and Feng Tingshen and the others stopped paying attention to her.
After Professor Liu left, Rong Ci took a sip of his drink. When he looked up, he found Qi Yuming looking at her over there with a half-smile.
Seeing her looking over, Qi Yuming raised his eyebrows and raised his wine glass towards her.
Rong Ci frowned, not understanding what Qi Yuming meant.
Qi Yuming seemed to sneer at her, and then looked away, no longer paying attention to her.
She probably felt that she and Yu Moxun had bullied Lin Wu, and Qi Yuming was telling her that this matter was not over yet.
After a while, the host of today's dinner finally came back after a busy time.
After chatting with them, he asked Yu Moxun: "Do you know that Miss Lin?"
"I got to know her a little while chatting before. I heard that she is not from the capital, but from City L. Her family's business is doing quite well now, and she is considered well-known in City L. However, these conditions are relatively small in the capital - especially with the Feng family and the He family.
